{{Top|leg}}
'''The Drop''' was an [[Ore/Legends|ore]]-smelting process applied at the [[Sarnus Refinery]], an industrial complex on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarnus]] in the [[Chiloon Rift/Legends|Chiloon Rift]] [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] owned by the businessman [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]. The Drop entailed [[astrolith]]s&mdash;fragments of [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] mined in the nebula and transported to Sarnus&mdash;being dropped from the planetary [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] into crash pits on the world's surface, from where they were transported via [[repulsi-veyer line]]s to grinding mills for processing. The [[Columi/Legends|Columi]] industrialist [[Marvid Qreph]] believed The Drop to be one of various outdated industrial techniques in use at the Sarnus Refinery. In [[45 ABY]], the [[biot]] [[Dena Yus]] sabotaged a drop on behalf of Marvid and his brother [[Craitheus Qreph|Craitheus]] by misaligning the refinery's protective [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]], resulting in the [[Destruction of Sarnus Refinery|destruction]] of the Sarnus Refinery and the [[Death/Legends|death]] of thirty thousand workers.<ref name="Crucible">[[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']]</ref>
 
==Behind the scenes==
The Drop appeared in the [[2013]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel [[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']], written by [[Troy Denning]].<ref name="Crucible" />
